topics.purpose: Define candidate resolution splitting overlapping responsibility into exact separately owned semantic scopes where consolidation is not appropriate.

semantics.conflict_rule: Source ownership conflict finding is exact.
semantics.owner_rule: Each partition receives one exact owner or explicit shared governance contract.
semantics.reference_rule: Consumers are remapped to exact partition identities where needed.
semantics.does_not_own_rule: Important negative ownership boundaries are added explicitly.
semantics.authority_rule: Semantic owner assignment does not grant runtime AccessCore rights.

invariants.rule: Whole-tree reconciliation operates only on exact accepted/candidate source snapshots, identities, references and declared semantics; it never repairs ambiguity through filename, path order, timestamp, nearest-name or UI layout heuristics.

A contract, closure set or repository remains unlocked/not-ready until all required reconciliation findings for its declared readiness profile are explicitly resolved or accepted through an explicit bounded exception.
